ننفطر (form VII)
# نَنْفَطِرُ (nanfaṭiru) /nan.fa.tˤi.ru/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْفَطَرَ (infaṭara)
# نَنْفَطِرَ (nanfaṭira) /nan.fa.tˤi.ra/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْفَطَرَ (infaṭara)
# نَنْفَطِرْ (nanfaṭir) /nan.fa.tˤir/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْفَطَرَ (infaṭara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
